scheme_name: Pension to Indigent Sportspersons of Odisha
other_conditions: Must have represented the State of Odisha in sporting disciplines recognized by the Sports & Youth Services Department (Annexure‑I).
Must be free from conviction in any criminal offence.
Age requirement may be relaxed by up to 10 years if the sportsperson is suddenly incapacitated by injury, physical handicap or serious ailment (Medical Board Certificate mandatory).
benefits_summary: A monthly pension of ₹3,000 is provided to indigent sportspersons of Odisha (with provision for the surviving spouse).
documents_required: Income Certificate from the Revenue authority
Medical Board Certificate (if seeking age relaxation due to injury/handicap)
